Corki|mid.identity: Mixed damage marksman (mostly magic). Phosphorus Bomb (Q) pokes in an area and reveals, Valkyrie (W) dashes him forward leaving a trail of fire, Gatling Gun (E) sprays in a cone while shredding resistances, and Missile Barrage (R) fires long-range missiles (a bigger one every third). He can regularly pick up The Package at base, which turns Valkyrie into a longer charge that knocks back.
Corki|mid.playstyle: Long-range poke and scaling. Corki is rarely played mid: if the roulette gives him to you in this role, play very carefully.
Corki|mid.early_game: Farm from range with Q and E, poke with Q when your opponent comes to last hit. Keep W to escape. Avoid any melee fight against assassins.
Corki|mid.level_1: Gatling Gun (E) first on the most common path. Farm and poke up close carefully.
Corki|mid.level_2: Phosphorus Bomb (Q) or Valkyrie (W) depending on your order. Q pokes in an area; W is your escape.
Corki|mid.level_3: Full basic kit: Q to poke, E for short trades, W to escape.
Corki|mid.level_6: Missile Barrage: long-range poke with charges. Harass your opponent with every charge, without exposing yourself.
power_spikes: Package available: engage or escape with the upgraded Valkyrie.
First completed item: much stronger poke.
Late game: constant poke in teamfights.
Corki|mid.lane_plan: Farm from range and poke with Q and R. Keep the wave in the middle or near you. Don't push without vision. Use The Package for a well-prepared engage with your jungler or to join a fight.
Corki|mid.trading: Basic trade: Q + R from range. Short trade: E up close, then back off. Only engage with The Package and your team; give up on it against assassins and burst mages.
threats: Almost every mid mage according to the data (Hwei, Viktor, Xerath, Syndra, Locke, Katarina).
A small data sample: the trends are less reliable.
mistakes: Using W to engage and having no escape left.
Forgetting to pick up The Package when it's available.

matchup_notes.Viktor: He pokes you and controls the area: farm from range.
matchup_notes.Ahri: Dodge her Charm and poke with R.
matchup_notes.Syndra: She outpokes you: stay behind your minions.
matchup_notes.Galio: Poke him before his level 6, then stay away from his ultimate.

Corki|mid.mid_game: Poke before objectives and play with your team. Avoid isolated side lanes.
Corki|mid.late_game: Constant long-range poke with R, and stay behind your frontline. The Package can be used to engage or reposition.
Corki|mid.ahead: Poke before objectives and take towers.
Corki|mid.behind: Farm from range and play with your team: don't force anything.
Corki|mid.win_condition: To win this game, you want to survive the lane and poke the enemy team before teamfights.
Corki|mid.final_tip: Play mid Corki as a long-range poker: never look for a melee duel.
